writeGateVerdict.reason: Observed Master Data context is useful for training and handbook work, but Foundation dependencies such as posting groups, VAT setup, payment terms, templates and item posting/inventory fields are not ready enough for direct writes.

customer.reason: Existing U-CUST-100 and customer card/list context are observed. A future narrow gate may edit or create only after number series/template and no-save boundaries are explicit.

routeAssessment.reason: A realistic customer project should not create scattered records by UI until posting, VAT, template and validation fields are mapped. UI remains important for training and one controlled example; Excel/configuration-package preparation is better for repeatable initial loads.
